name: Etch a Sketch
storyline: Grizelda the witch has shaken things up inside the Etch A Sketch, and Knobby must restore draw and order. Help Knobby save his kidnapped friend. Stop Grizelda's evil plan to turn everything in the Land of Aha! to Dullsville.
summary: The timeless drawing toy Etch A Sketch comes out of the classic red box and comes alive on your computer screen! Grizelda the witch has shaken things up in the Land of Aha and Knobby needs your help. Experience the World’s Favorite Drawing Toy as you use your mouse to sketch unique masterpieces and help Knobby on his quest in adventure mode.
